title: Persona 3 Reload
shortDescription: Ground-up remake of the Gekkoukan High classic utilizing modern UI aesthetics, Shift battle mechanics, and fully voiced links.
historicalSignificance: Preserved the poignant philosophical soul of Persona 3 while elevating audio, animation, and dungeon exploration.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
